label: Type I multimode SOI edge coupler for FP laser diodes, 2 input tips (gap 1.5 um), integrated 2-way split
core_material: Si 220 nm on 2 um buried SiO2, 200 mm SOI; 180 nm wide inverse-tapered input tips
process_name: ePIXfab, IMEC 200 mm CMOS pilot line, 193 nm DUV lithography
notes: Two 180 nm tips at 1.5 um gap prolonged as an interference section, up-tapered to 400 nm and separated by S-bends; outputs to two single-mode waveguides read through grating couplers (p.5 Sec. II-D, Fig. 1(a)). The chip carries a series of interference-section lengths (polishing compensation, p.6): the 1.8 dB lensed-fiber value is the 62.7 um device, the 60 nm bandwidth the 60.7 um device (balanced at 1550 nm); the laser-diode values (Table I) are on the 'best structure in terms of imbalance', length not stated (p.8). Measured half beat length about 23.5 um vs 22.8 um simulated (p.7). Not in the registry: Table I does not separate x and z (prints x-z tolerance +/-1.4 um). Fab: fabricated within the ePIXfab network in the IMEC 200 mm CMOS pilot line (p.6 Sec. III-A); ePIXfab (MPW access, D398) is not in the registry.

label: Type II multimode SOI edge coupler for FP laser diodes, 5 input tips (gap 0.8 um), rib MMI and Y-junction split
core_material: Si 220 nm on 2 um buried SiO2, 200 mm SOI; 180 nm wide inverse-tapered input tips; 70 nm shallow-etched rib sections (5 um wide rib, 0.45 um output ribs)

notes: Sections (1)-(5): input tips, 50 um tapers into a 5 um rib (0.88 um tips, final gap 100 nm), 50 um taper down to 1 um to cut off the second-order mode, short phase-adjust rib, Y-junction into two 0.45 um ribs, rib-to-strip transitions (p.5-6 Sec. II-E). Fabricated: input section 29 um after polishing and 3.3 um section 4 instead of 1.7 um (Y-junction gap below process resolution adds 2.6 um, p.7). Design statements not entered: full-to-shallow transition 0.8 dB extra loss (origin not stated), taper and Y-junction losses below 0.1 dB (simulated). label: Si3N4 focusing grating emitter, 674 nm, 2 um focus 50 um above the chip, Si substrate as bottom reflector
core_material: LPCVD stoichiometric Si3N4 120 nm on 1.5 um thermal SiO2 on Si; single-mode feed (540 nm wide, quasi-TE) expanding through a taper into a curved, apodized grating; e-beam lithography (HSQ), CHF3/O2 RIE
notes: Design: focus w0 = 2.0 um, z = 50 um, average angle -30 deg; grating arc radii equal to the distance from the taper start (p.2-3). Design period about 300-334 nm and etched-fraction duty cycle about 0.1-0.42 along y (Fig. 2(e)-(f) curves; not entered). Not in the registry: measured minimum waists at about 54 um (y) and 40 um (x) height (p.4); sidelobes characterized to the 5e-6 relative-intensity level within 25 um, below 1e-3 beyond 10 um along y (p.4); polarization impurity < 3e-4 relative intensity at the focus center, polarizer-limited (p.5); simulated 36 % without the Si reflector (p.2). Fab from the author contributions (K.K.M. fabricated, MIT; p.6; D395). Nanostructures Lab staff thanked: not a facility entry.

label: Dual-gain InP / TFLN Vernier extended-cavity laser, photonic wire bonded
core_material: two InP amplifier waveguides photonic-wire-bonded into one cavity with a TFLN feedback circuit (Vernier double ring, thermo-optic phase shifter, two-MZI tunable outcoupler); output PWB to a fiber array; Peltier and on-chip thermistor
cladding: PECVD SiO2 with an ALD Al2O3 sealing layer
notes: Not in the registry: 58 h mode-hop-free run with a 4.4 MHz/h frequency-drift trend, power variation < +/-0.2 mW (p.7, Fig. 4(c)-(d)); effective cavity length about 24 cm (p.7); calculated intrinsic linewidth of order 100 Hz (p.5); 20 km delay Voigt fit gives a similar linewidth (p.5). Multimode operation more likely above 525 mA; power degraded after the 78 mW measurement (moisture in the PECVD cladding, p.7). Fab: InP amplifiers from an unnamed semiconductor foundry; no fabricating org named for the TFLN chip (p.3) or the PWBs; TFLN fabrication performed in the Center for Nanoscale Systems, Harvard (p.8). Cross-notes: cmp_lit_franken2025_pwb_inp_tfln, _pwb_tfln_fiber, _vernier_rings, _tfln_waveguide, _to_phase_shifter.

label: Self-isolating Si3N4 Vernier ECTL with RSOA, PDH-stabilized to an on-chip 4 m coil-loaded MZI
core_material: InP RSOA (Thorlabs SAF1128C; 90 % HR / 0.005 % AR, 5.6 deg facet) edge-coupled to an 80 nm Si3N4 extended cavity (18 um wide facet taper angled 13.1 deg, two Vernier rings, tunable Sagnac loop mirror, phase section), monolithic with the 4 m coil-loaded MZI; feedback to the RSOA current

notes: Same Vernier ring radii as merged heim2025 (authors' ref. 52) but 2.8 um ring waveguides (p.9, p.16) and 6 um cladding; new monolithic chip with the stabilization circuit. Not in the registry: ADEV 6.5e-13 at 0.08 ms, 225 kHz/s drift (p.7); lock bandwidth 0.1 MHz (0.1-0.3 MHz, p.18); about 6 orders of frequency-noise suppression near 100 Hz (p.7); error-signal slope 0.45 MHz/V at 1540 nm (p.17). Self-isolation over -30 dB cited to ref. 52: not entered (rule 3). The RSOA-to-Si3N4 butt coupling has no stated loss: no coupler row. Fab: the contributions statement (p.13) names K.D.N. (Honeywell Aerospace) as the fabricator of the chips (D395, D399; heim2025 coil precedent); Methods (p.9) says only 'fabricated in a CMOS foundry'. D.A.S.H. (UCSB) built the ECTL with the purchased RSOA (p.13): UCSB on this assembled row (D399). Cross-notes: cmp_lit_heim2026_ectl_vernier_rings, _coil_4m.

Enhanced optical intensity 234 % at 1540 nm (p.5) is not tied to a lens in the text and has no parameter. Fabricated unit-element dimensions are in the supplement (Table S1, not cached). In scope as a fiber-coupled passive part (D411). Simulated unit-cell values (periodic array, not lens metrics; not entered): with SEM-measured dimensions 1499.3 nm resonance and 16.9 % RCP-to-LCP conversion (p.3); optimized design unit 1482.6 nm, 17 % (p.2). Fig. 5(b) render: the NA 0.37 curve peaks near 1510 nm at about 17 %, the NA 0.23 curve at about 16 % near 1530-1540 nm (read +/- 0.5 %), so neither printed maximum (16.1 % at 1530 nm, 16.4 % at 1540 nm) maps to one curve.
